outgoing.name: Fossil record
outgoing.excerpt: Beetles entered the fossil record during the Lower Permian, about 265 million years ago.

outgoing.name: Mummy
outgoing.excerpt: Some scholars suggest that the people's practice of making mummies was inspired by the brooding process of the beetle.
